_comment: forest_tree_prop_c: the leaner: a ~1.15 m trunk leaning ~17 deg, forking at 5 m into two thick limbs and easing upright to 11 m, every limb sweeping level into the lane roof and ending in a flat leaf pad; 17.6 m to its top pad. A loose prop for map 3's lane, placed by hand as cover on the path; origin at the foot of the trunk on the ground plane so it drops onto the lane at identity. One material (the forest atlas, shared with forest_build.py), one contiguous mesh. ForestTreePropCCollision is the purpose-built collider shipped as a `-colonly` node -- the trunk's own silhouette, not a box, so a runner behind the trunk is behind the collider at every height a runner can occupy; the crown does not collide. Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and drops its mesh, so `surfaces` counts only what is drawn.
